_comment: Guided tour of every 639-owned (blue) room. Straight axis-aligned legs between waypoints; a waypoint with a `room` label is a hold there. The tour build starts the project-room glass door closed; `action: open-project-door` stops beside its wall switch and waits for the two-second opening before the route crosses the clear middle bay to the patio, then enters the guest bedroom. Each move leg is a servo compiled into the player's Forth by blender_create_condo.py (CONDO_TOUR=…). Pace: ground speed ≈ accel/(30·decel). docs/plans/2026-09-19-condo-639-tour-video.md A waypoint's `hold` overrides hold_seconds: the two patio stops hold 3 s each and the master-bedroom window stop 5 s so the balcony and window cameras' 5 s pans play out.
